_about: Headline counts from the full check (one standard for every candidate in a race; research files in the vote-informed Claude project, doc claude/full-check-standard.md). Read by scripts/money-summary.mjs into public/data/money-summary.json as fullCheck, which replaces the automatic one-line summary for these people. Decisions = contested votes, budget requests, bills they sponsored that became law, and actions their own office chose (lawsuits, settlements, grants, contracts it awarded by solicitation or signed directly). Not counted: uncontested votes and routine buying. Helped = an official record shows the donor benefited and the person voted yes or took the action. Checked Oct 27, 2026.
